# The static assets route is registered under the routes function's path
# prefix and wrapped by its middleware, like the template routes.

muxt generate --input-static-assets-directory=assets --output-static-assets-path=/static --use-receiver-type=Server --output-routes-func-with-path-prefix-param --output-routes-func-with-middleware-param
muxt check
exec go test -count=1

-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}
-- assets/app.css --
p{color:red}
-- index.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}<link rel="stylesheet" href="{{.Path.ReadStatic}}app.css">{{end}}
-- server.go --
package server

func (Server) Index() string { return "" }
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func TestStaticAssetsUnderPrefix(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	paths := TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{}, "/app", func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(res http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
			res.Header().Set("X-Wrapped", "yes")
			next.ServeHTTP(res, req)
		})
	})

	if got, want := paths.ReadStatic(), "/app/static/"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("ReadStatic() = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}

	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/app/static/app.css", nil))
	if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Errorf("GET /app/static/app.css status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusOK)
	}
	if got := rec.Header().Get("X-Wrapped"); got != "yes" {
		t.Errorf("GET /app/static/app.css X-Wrapped = %q, want %q", got, "yes")
	}
	if got, want := rec.Body.String(), "p{color:red}\n"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("GET /app/static/app.css body = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}

	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/static/app.css", nil))
	if rec.Code != http.StatusNotFound {
		t.Errorf("GET /static/app.css status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusNotFound)
	}
}
